//deviation_1_pdn: The block is 27.44 um wide, narrower than the 38.87 um stripe pitch, so one Metal4 VPWR/VGND stripe pair WILL lie over the column (unlike the chip anchors, which are stripe-free). //deviation_2_taps: No tap cells inside the block: FP_TAPCELL_DIST is set above the row width, so the only well ties are the 2-site endcaps at both row ends. The 5 V rule DF.13_MV/DF.14_MV allows at most 15 um to a tie; the farthest column point is about 9.5 um from an endcap. This differs from the chip (staggered filltie checkerboard, worst 10.3 um via the neighbour row) and must be confirmed with KLayout DRC (feol=true), since Magic does not check it.
